Molecular mechanisms of ferroptosis The figure illustrates the three-axis framework driving ferroptosis: the proferroptotic driver axis (iron and oxidizable lipids), the antioxidant defense axis (e.g., the glutathione/GPX4 system), and the integrative regulatory axis (key transcription factors and enzymes). It details the interconnected networks of iron metabolism (uptake, storage, and Fenton reaction), lipid metabolism (peroxidation of PUFAs), amino acid metabolism (cystine uptake and glutathione synthesis), and other key regulatory molecules that collectively determine cellular sensitivity to ferroptosis. α-KG: α-Ketoglutarate; α-KG: α-ketoglutarate; Acetyl-CoA: Acetyl-coenzyme A; ACSL4: Acetyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4; AFT4: Activating transcription factor 4; CoA: Coenzyme A; CoQ10: coenzyme Q10; FSP1: Ferroptosis suppressor protein 1; FTH: Ferritin; FTL: Ferritin light chain; GLS2: Glutaminase 2; GPX4: GSH peroxidase 4; GR: Glutathione reductase; GSS: Glutathione synthetase; GSSG: Glutathione disulfide (oxidized glutathione; GSH: Glutathione; HMG: High-mobility; HMG-CoA: HMG-CoA: β-hydroxy; IPP: Isopentenyl pyrophosphate; Iso-Cit: Isocitrate; LPCAT3: Lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase 3; Mal: Malate; NADPH: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate; Nrf2: nuclear factor erythroid2-related factor 2; PPP: Pentose phosphate pathway; PUFA: Polyunsaturated fatty acid; PL-PUFA-OH: phospholipid-polyunsaturated fatty acid-hydroxyl; SLC1A5: Solute carrier family 1 member 5; SLC3A2: Solute carrier family 3 member 2; SLC38A1: Solute carrier family 38 member 1; SLC7A11: Solute carrier family 7 member 11; STEAP3: Six-transmembrane epithelial antigen of the prostate 3; TF: Transferrin; TFR1: transferrin receptor 1; YAP: Yes-associated protein.
